scope: Capital projects and infrastructure spending in the 33 counties of the Baldwin County 50-mile coverage area, verified against the cited source on the review date. Supplements projects.json, jones-projects.json, regional-projects.json and project-evidence.json; it does not change them.
money_rules: Amounts are copied exactly as printed in the cited source (dollars). Rounded amounts reported in news are marked approximate.

paid = documented payments; reported = officially reported spending, not independently confirmed as paid; contract = executed or awarded contract; budget = approved budget, allocation or grant award; estimate = projected or estimated cost.

School SPLOST schedules: 'original estimated cost' (the referendum resolution) is shown as the approved allocation and 'current estimated cost' as an estimate. Where a schedule prints only current-year and prior-year spending, the to-date figure is their sum and is labeled that way.
Shared multi-county contracts and estimates are one record listed under each county. They are never divided or repeated as county amounts.
